'''February 2000 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, New York on 20 February 2000. [[Dennis Shea]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d272">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-williston-park-new-york-2-20-00d272/ williston-park-new-york-2-20-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 20 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-williston-park-new-york-2-20-00d272/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Dennis Shea]]
